title.narrative: Strengthening Indigenous Languages, Community Media and Cultural Diversity

description.narrative: Mexico is home to a rich diversity of indigenous languages and cultures, many of which face increasing risks of decline and limited access to public services and media. This project aims to protect and revitalize indigenous languages while promoting cultural diversity, linguistic rights and inclusion. Key activities include supporting public policies for language preservation, training communicators and indigenous, community and Afro-descendant media outlets, improving interpretation and translation services in health and justice settings, creating spaces for intergenerational learning, and launching a national awareness campaign. Expected results include stronger community media, greater use of Indigenous languages, improved access to services, and increased recognition of Mexico’s cultural and linguistic diversity.
